claim_text: Planet IC says there was unauthorised access to servers in its data centre on Nov 21
summary: Planet IC, an IT and hosting company in Schwerin, Germany, says that as far as it currently knows there was unauthorised access to servers in its data centre on the evening of Saturday, Nov 21.
detail: Planet IC told the German news agency dpa that the intruders got into its system on Nov 21. It has not said how they got in.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Planet IC: "Nach derzeitigem Kenntnisstand kam es Samstagabend, 21. November, zu einem unbefugten Zugriff auf Server unseres Rechenzentrums." dpa and Börsen-Zeitung carry the same account.

claim_text: Planet IC took several web servers and services offline, and the websites on them with them
summary: Planet IC says that once it knew of the unauthorised access it took several web servers and services offline as a precaution, and the websites hosted on them went offline too. It says it is bringing all systems back step by step.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Planet IC to dpa: "haben wir mehrere Webserver bzw. Dienste sicherheitshalber vom Netz genommen und die darauf gehosteten Webseiten vorsorglich offline gestellt". Börsen-Zeitung says the same.

claim_text: Forensic experts and the state criminal police are investigating; regulators have been told
summary: Planet IC says outside forensic experts and the Landeskriminalamt (state criminal police) are involved, and that the data protection commissioner of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and the federal cyber security agency, the BSI, have been informed.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Planet IC: "externe Forensik-Experten sowie das Landeskriminalamt (LKA) bereits eingebunden" and the state data protection commissioner and the BSI "sind ebenfalls informiert".

claim_text: Planet IC has not said whether any data was taken
summary: Planet IC's notice does not say whether data was taken, and dpa reports that Planet IC gave no details on how long the outage would last, its consequences or any possible data theft.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Nordkurier (dpa): "Zur Länge des Ausfalls, den Folgen und dem möglichen Datenabfluss machte Planet IC keine Angaben." Planet IC's notice does not mention data.

claim_text: Wemag says the attackers potentially had access to customer data in its customer portals
summary: Wemag, an energy supplier in Schwerin, says the attackers potentially had access to customer data in its customer portals. The analysis continues, the authorities have been told, and affected customers will be informed.
detail: Wemag has not said what data or how many customers.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Wemag: "Nach aktuellem Kenntnisstand hatten die Angreifer potenziell Zugriff auf Kundendaten in den Kundenportalen." and "Die Meldungen bei den zuständigen Aufsichtsbehörden sind erfolgt."

claim_text: Public broadcaster NDR reports that Wemag customer data got out
summary: Security-Insider reports that, according to the public broadcaster NDR, Wemag customer data was leaked. Wemag's own statement says only that the attackers potentially had access to it.
detail: We did not find the NDR report itself.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Security-Insider: "Nach NDR-Angaben sind Kundendaten von Wemag nach außen gelangt."

claim_text: Wemag's customer portals and online tariff sign-up are down; power, grid, internet and phone are not affected
summary: Wemag says several websites and the customer portals of Wemag and its telecoms arm Wemacom are offline, and tariffs cannot be taken out online. Its power, grid, internet and phone services work normally.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Wemag: "Seitdem sind mehrere Websites sowie die Kundenportale ... der WEMAG und der WEMACOM nicht erreichbar" and power, grid, internet and phone "funktionieren uneingeschränkt".

claim_text: City websites in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, including Schwerin, Greifswald and Waren, went down
summary: The websites of several city administrations in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, among them Schwerin, Greifswald and Waren an der Müritz, were unavailable after the attack on Planet IC, according to dpa and NDR. Some showed temporary pages instead.
detail: Security-Insider, citing NDR, lists the Ämter Rostocker Heide and Züssow, the housing company Wobau Wismar, DKB Grund and the Ehrenamtsstiftung MV among Planet IC customers whose websites were down.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Nordkurier (dpa): "Die Störungen betreffen mehrere Internetauftritte der Stadtverwaltungen in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, darunter Schwerin, Greifswald und Waren an der Müritz." Security-Insider (NDR) names the same.

claim_text: NRW.BANK's website is running in a limited form; applications are still possible
summary: NRW.BANK, North Rhine-Westphalia's state development bank, took its website offline as a precaution after the attack on its IT provider. On Nov 27 its site said it was limited and applications could still be made.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Börsen-Zeitung: the bank took its site offline over an attack on its IT provider. NRW.BANK: "Die Website der NRW.BANK steht derzeit nur eingeschränkt zur Verfügung" and "Die Antragstellung ist weiterhin möglich."

claim_text: NRW.BANK says there is no sign it was affected or that its data was taken
summary: NRW.BANK told Börsen-Zeitung there are no indications that it was affected, and so none of data being taken. The paper notes no bank data can be taken from the website.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Börsen-Zeitung: the bank said there were "keinerlei Hinweise, insofern auch nicht für einen Datenabfluss" (no indications at all, and so none of a data outflow).

claim_text: Schwerin's and Greifswald's websites, Wemag's customer portal and NRW.BANK's site were still down or limited on Nov 27
summary: At our check on the evening of Nov 27, Schwerin's city website showed a temporarily-unavailable page, Greifswald's was very limited, Wemag's customer portal was down and NRW.BANK's site was limited. Wemag's main site worked.
detail: Schwerin's online service portal still works. Waren an der Müritz's website did not respond at our check. Planet IC has given no date for full restoration.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Schwerin: "kann www.schwerin.de derzeit nicht aufgerufen werden". Greifswald: "nur stark eingeschränkt". Wemag portal: "vorübergehend nicht erreichbar". NRW.BANK: "nur eingeschränkt".

claim_text: Nobody has been named as behind the attack
summary: Planet IC, Wemag and the outlets that reported the attack name no person or group behind it, and no group has been reported claiming it.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: None of Planet IC's notice, Wemag's release, dpa's report or Security-Insider names an attacker or a claim of responsibility. Security-Insider: how access was gained "ist noch nicht bekannt".

claim_text: Wemag tells customers to change a reused portal password and to watch for fake messages
summary: Wemag advises customers who use their portal password elsewhere to change it, and to be careful with emails, texts and calls that seem to come from Wemag or Wemacom. It says it never asks for passwords by email or text.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Wemag: "Sollten Sie das Passwort Ihres Kundenportals auch für andere Dienste nutzen, empfehlen wir, es vorsorglich zu ändern" and it never asks for passwords "per E-Mail oder SMS".

claim_text: Wemag says its external hosting provider was attacked and its portals were affected
summary: Wemag says an external hosting provider of the Wemag group had a cyber security incident that took its customer portals and several websites offline. Outlets identify that provider as Planet IC.
detail: Wemag's release does not name the provider; Security-Insider and Schwerin Lokal link it to Planet IC.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Wemag: "Ein externer Hosting-Dienstleister der WEMAG-Unternehmensgruppe ist von einem Cybersicherheitsvorfall betroffen." Security-Insider lists Wemag among Planet IC's customers.

claim_text: NRW.BANK says its IT provider was attacked and took its website offline
summary: NRW.BANK, the state development bank of North Rhine-Westphalia, uses Planet IC: Börsen-Zeitung reports the security incident in Planet IC's data centre led to customer websites, including the bank's, being taken offline.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Börsen-Zeitung: "Aufgrund eines Hackerangriffs bei ihrem IT-Dienstleister hat die NRW.Bank ihre Website vom Netz nehmen müssen"; the incident was "im Rechenzentrum von Planet IC".

claim_text: The city of Schwerin's website is offline; outlets link it to Planet IC
summary: Schwerin, the state capital of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, says its website is temporarily offline for technical reasons, without naming a cause. dpa and Schwerin Lokal report it among the sites hit by the attack on Planet IC.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Schwerin: "Die Website ist aus technischen Gründen vorübergehend abgeschaltet." Schwerin Lokal: the city gives no specific reason. dpa lists Schwerin among the city sites affected.

claim_text: Greifswald and Waren an der Müritz are reported among Planet IC's affected customers
summary: dpa reports that the city websites of Greifswald and Waren an der Müritz were affected by the attack on Planet IC. At our check Greifswald's site said it was only available in a very limited form.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Nordkurier (dpa) names Greifswald and Waren an der Müritz among the affected city websites. Greifswald: "nur stark eingeschränkt".

claim_text: Security-Insider names other Planet IC customers whose sites went down
summary: Security-Insider, citing NDR, says the websites of the Ämter Rostocker Heide and Züssow, the housing company Wobau Wismar, DKB Grund and the Ehrenamtsstiftung MV, all Planet IC customers, were unavailable.
detail: These organisations have not said so on a page of their own that we could find.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Security-Insider: "Zu den Kunden von Planet IC, deren Internetauftritte nicht erreichbar sind, gehören ... die Ämter Rostocker Heide und Züssow" and Wobau Wismar, DKB Grund, Ehrenamtsstiftung MV.

claim_text: Planet IC is a Schwerin digital agency, IT company and data centre operator founded in 1992
summary: Planet IC describes itself as one of the largest digital agencies with an IT systems house and data centre in northern Germany, working since 1992 with about 50 staff, making websites and digital processes, also for banks and utilities.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Planet IC: "eine der größten Digitalagenturen mit IT-Systemhaus & Rechenzentrum in Norddeutschland. Seit 1992" and "mit 50 Mitarbeitern, seit 1992".

claim_text: Amt Crivitz says its website is off because it uses Planet IC
summary: Amt Crivitz, a local administration near Schwerin, told Nordkurier its website is switched off as a precaution because it uses Planet IC, and it does not know when it will return. Its site shows a temporarily-unavailable page.
detail: Nordkurier says the site has been unreachable since the start of the week of Nov 23. Amt Crivitz gave no other details and referred questions to Planet IC.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Nordkurier quotes the head of the Amt: "Da wir uns des Dienstleisters Planet IC bedienen, ist unsere Internetseite vorläufig vorsorglich abgeschaltet". Amt Crivitz site: "Unsere Website ist vorübergehend nicht erreichbar."
